name: IFTTT
description: Connect IFTTT to Claude to run actions, query data, and manage your automations across 1,000+ services. Claude can search your apps for info, execute tasks on demand, and create or update Applets for you. Use simple natural language to let Claude save you time by handling repetitive tasks, syncing data between productivity apps, and controlling smart home devices directly from the chat.

_published_faq.name: How do I add IFTTT to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add IFTTT to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ifttt.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the IFTTT MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: IFTTT lists 14 MCP tools, including get_user_info, get_services, search_services, get_triggers, get_actions, get_queries, run_action, run_query, search_applets, get_applet, create_applet, and enable_applet.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to IFTTT?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to IFTTT in automation-workflows on the Manufact MCP catalog include Sidewave Maggiordomo, Corsair Cloud, Fleet Workspace, Whalesync, and typenode-mcp.
IFTTT requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
IFTTT is developed by IFTTT, Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
